node-1.label: A 19-year-old male presents with headache described as blurred vision when hearing noise, followed by intermittent tingling at the top of the head, lasting about 5 minutes and occurring 5-6 times a day for the past 5 months

node-2.label: Past history includes encephalitis with high fever at age 5, followed by seizures at age 9; seizures were well-controlled with medication for the past 7 years

node-3.label: Patient became irritable with suicidal intentions a year ago and was diagnosed with anxiety disorder

node-4.label: Born at term with home delivery, normal physical growth (height 172.4 cm, weight 97.3 kg), no family history of mental illness or genetic disorders

node-5.label: Physical examination: right-handed male with symmetrical face and limbs, no abnormal walking gait; MMSE score 21 indicating mild mental retardation
